The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, USG Analytics (Backend & AI) within USG Analytics, you will play a critical role in delivering innovative technology solutions that transform how U.S. government organizations operate.

At USG Analytics, we combine engineering rigor, product thinking, and cutting-edge AI to enable meaningful impact for our clients. In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and deploying agentic and generative AI-powered solutions, modern workflow tools, and scalable applications within secure government environments. This is a hands-on role where you will thrive on building and shipping real systems that address complex and meaningful challenges.

You will design and implement agentic AI systems and generative AI-enabled workflows that drive efficiency and innovation for government clients. Your work will involve developing scalable, secure applications that integrate seamlessly across enterprise systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance and compliance. Collaborating closely with designers and product managers, you will translate user needs into functional, impactful software solutions. Additionally, you will work directly with government stakeholders and client service teams, ensuring that the solutions you deliver align with their unique requirements and objectives.

In this role, you will also drive innovation while maintaining operational excellence. You will build and deploy AI-enabled applications across cloud environments, implementing advanced systems such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent orchestration frameworks, tool-calling architectures, and secure API integrations. Your responsibilities will include developing backend services, data pipelines, and application logic, while also contributing to frontend or workflow-layer development as needed.

As part of your solution engineering responsibilities, you will architect modular, reusable, and platform-flexible solutions that can adapt to evolving client needs. You will evaluate AI models and platforms to ensure they meet performance, security, and operational requirements, while also ensuring observability, monitoring, and reliability of deployed systems.

Your role will also involve direct client engagement, where you will translate complex client challenges into actionable technical implementation plans. You will collaborate closely with client technical teams to ensure seamless integration and adoption of new AI-enabled workflows. Additionally, you will provide training and support to end users, empowering them to fully leverage the capabilities of the solutions you deliver.

Continuous innovation will be a key aspect of your work. You will prototype rapidly to test new agentic and generative AI capabilities, contributing to internal libraries, accelerators, and reusable components that enhance the efficiency and scalability of our solutions. Staying current on advances in AI systems and workflow technologies will be essential, enabling you to bring the latest innovations to your work and deliver cutting-edge solutions to our clients.

Through your efforts, you will help USG Analytics deliver transformative technology solutions that enable U.S. government organizations to operate more effectively, efficiently, and securely. Your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on addressing some of the most pressing challenges faced by government clients today.

The role focuses on building scalable, high-throughput, low-latency services and machine learning solutions that help determine effective ad selection across Disney's media platforms. The engineer will work with both rule-based and ML-based approaches while contributing to software architecture, observability, testing, and system reliability.

The position also involves modern AI technologies, including large-scale ML/DL platforms, LLM-based applications, agent frameworks, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation.

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

Noblis is seeking Data Scientists at all experience levels with an active TS/SCI with a Polygraph to support mission-critical national security initiatives in Chantilly, Virginia.

As a Data Scientist, you will support the intelligence community by developing innovative, data-driven solutions to address mission-critical challenges. You will provide technical expertise to government customers through the development of machine learning, statistical analysis, and data mining solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, software engineers, subject matter experts, and cyber analysts to apply advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI techniques. Additionally, you will contribute to the full model lifecycle, including model development, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and vulnerability identification.

Your work will directly contribute to capabilities such as object detection, data triage, search optimization, inference, facial recognition, behavior analysis, and automated decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have experience analyzing cyber data and applying data science methodologies to solve complex customer problems, with strong proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI/ML technologies and cloud-based environments.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data using open-source datasets, statistical software, cloud services, and AI/ML technologies to identify meaningful patterns, relationships, and insights Support production AI/ML infrastructure and operations, including platform maintenance, issue triage, troubleshooting, and user support Support Kubernetes-based platform operations, including the use of management and deployment tools to maintain and optimize AI/ML environments Work with containerized model-serving environments, contributing to configuration updates, authentication, troubleshooting, and operational support for LLM and multimodal AI capabilities Explore and model data to identify relevant patterns, trends, relationships, and features of interest Design, develop, train, evaluate, and refine machine learning models to support mission-focused applications Collect, curate, clean, transform, and process large-scale structured and unstructured datasets for analytical and machine learning applications Research, implement, evaluate, and document analytical methodologies, models, and outcomes Leverage high-performance computing (HPC) resources, including GPU clusters and cloud-based platforms, to support large-scale data processing and model development Develop data visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Tableau to effectively communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders 

#HighlyCleared

Required Qualifications

Active Top Secret/SCI (TS/SCI) with Polygraph U.S. Citizenship is requiredTravel up to 10% within US.Lift up to 30 lbs, walk, bend, drive.

One Of The Following

Junior level

Bachelor's or Master's degree with 1 year of related experience including exposure or coursework in data science tools and technologies such as Python; OR Associate's degree with 3 years of related experience; OR High School diploma/GED with 6 years of related experience Compensation: $82,500 - $128,925

Mid-level

Bachelor's degree with 3 years of related experience; OR Master's degree with 1 year of related experience; OR Associate's degree with 6 years of related experience; OR High School diploma/GED with 9 years of related experience Experience with data science tools and technologies, including analyzing data in Python Compensation: $90,700 - $141,775

Senior level

Bachelor's degree with 5 years of related experience; OR Master's degree with 3 years of related experience; OR Associate's degree with 8 years of related experience; OR High School diploma/GED with 11 years of related experience Experience with data science tools and technologies, including analyzing data in PythonCompensation: $120,700 - $188,725

Desired Qualifications

Proficiency in data science tools and technologies such as SQL/PostgreSQL, Apache Spark, and Git Experience with machine learning, statistical modeling, and/or time-series forecasting Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau to communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS Experience working with cyber data, including platforms such as Shodan and Censys Experience working with open-source and large-scale datasets Demonstrated ability to clean, transform, manage, and optimize large, complex datasets for analytical and machine learning applications Fundamental understanding of a range of AI/ML techniques, with the ability to select and apply appropriate methods to address specific problems Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to diverse audiences Familiarity with developing, retraining, or using AI and machine learning packages Knowledge of software and hardware optimization techniques for large-scale data processing Proficiency in data warehousing, data management, and ETL tools (e.g., Apache NiFi, Pentaho, Kafka) Experience supporting Kubernetes-based platform operations and containerized model-serving environments Advanced degree in a data science equivalent field or sub-field 

Overview

Overview

Noblis and our wholly owned subsidiaries, Noblis ESI and Noblis MSD, take on some of the nation’s toughest challenges, delivering advanced solutions to our customers’ most critical missions. We bring together leading scientific, engineering, and management expertise in a culture grounded in objectivity and collaboration, ensuring our work creates lasting impact across federal missions.

We work with a broad range of government agencies in the defense, intelligence, and federal civilian sectors. Learn more and find opportunities at careers.noblis.org

Why Work at Noblis

At Noblis, we share a passion for excellence and innovation, and we create an environment where people can do meaningful work while maintaining the balance that keeps them energized and fulfilled. We seek out individuals with a natural curiosity and desire to collaborate and learn. We believe our people are our greatest strength, and we consistently seek exceptionally skilled, mission‑driven professionals who care deeply about doing work that enriches lives and makes our nation safer.

Noblis has earned numerous workplace awards for our culture, our commitment to employee well‑being, and our dedication to meaningful, impactful work. We also maintain a drug‑free workplace.

Remote/hybrid status is subject to change based on Noblis and/or government requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, sex, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability, pregnancy/childbirth and related medical conditions, veteran or military status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us.

EEO is the Law | E-Verify | Right to Work

Total Rewards

At Noblis we recognize and reward your contributions, provide you with growth opportunities, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Benefits page on our Careers site.

Compensation at Noblis is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the combination of education, certifications, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, internal and external equity, location, clearance level, as well as contract-specific affordability, organizational requirements and applicable employment laws. The projected compensation range for this position is based on full time status. For part time or on-call staff, compensation is proportionately adjusted based on hours worked. rows.title: Applied Researcher I (AI Foundations)
rows.descriptionText:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

In this role, you will: 

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. The incumbent provides referrals and assists clients in navigating specific medical services, which include but are not limited to primary care, mental health, alcohol/substance use, and HIV case management. rows.title: Brinson Prize Fellowship 2027
rows.descriptionText:
The Brinson Foundation announces the call for applications for postdoctoral fellowships under the Brinson Prize Fellowship Program beginning in the fall of 2027. The Space Telescope Science Institute is collaborating with The Brinson Foundation in support of this program.

Brinson Prize Fellowships are awarded to early-career astrophysicists and cosmologists who are committed to chasing bold ideas with creative, nimble, and innovative research. The awards support ambitious research in observational cosmology, with a focus on projects that complement and capitalize on the latest space science. Proposals describing instrumentation development should be connected with observing the sky, and all proposals should include a science communication plan and ideas for future engagement with broad audiences.

The fellowship is open to applicants who have earned (or will have earned) their doctoral degree on or after January 1, 2023 in astronomy, physics, or related disciplines. The duration of the Fellowship is up to three years.

We anticipate offering up to three Brinson Prize Fellowships this year. The Fellowships are tenable at the following participating U.S. institutions:

California Institute of TechnologyCornell UniversityHarvard UniversityJohns Hopkins UniversityMassachusetts Institute of TechnologyNorthwestern UniversityPrinceton UniversityStanford UniversityThe Ohio State UniversityUniversity of ArizonaUniversity of California, BerkeleyUniversity of ChicagoUniversity of HawaiiUniversity of MichiganUniversity of Washington

rows.title: Content Designer (SEO / GEO / AEO) - Boots Online Doctor
rows.descriptionText:
Closing Date: Wednesday 30th September

Location: Islington, London (hybrid - travel to office as required)

Contract: Permanent

Recruitment Partner: Frankie McCallister-Lyas

About The Role

Welcome to the Digital Experience team at Boots Online Doctor – we shape the online journeys that help people find, understand and access the care they need. Boots Online Doctor offers more than 45 healthcare services and has supported over 1.6 million patients. We work closely with clinical, compliance, marketing, product and design colleagues to make every step of the online experience clear, trustworthy and easy to use. As more people turn to search engines and AI tools for health information, we’re focused on making sure that what they find from us is accurate, helpful and easy to act on.

As our Content Designer, you’ll turn complex clinical and regulatory information into clear, accessible content that helps patients make confident, informed decisions about their health. You’ll bring together content design and search expertise – SEO, generative engine optimisation (GEO) and answer engine optimisation (AEO) – so our content is found, trusted and cited across Google search, AI Overviews and AI answer engines. This is a new role reporting to the Head of Digital Experience, with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

 Design, brief and collaborate to provide clear, accessible content for our condition, treatment and service pages, online consultation journeys and campaigns – working with writers and delivering to deadline in a current and future content management system (CMS). Turn complex clinical, pharmaceutical and regulatory information into plain, easy-to-follow content that helps patients understand their options and act with confidence. Own how your content performs in search and AI answers – structuring it for organic search, Google AI Overviews and answer engines using structured data, question-led formats and strong E-E-A-T signals (such as author credentials, medical review, citations and clear sourcing). Work within our clinical and regulatory sign-off process, partnering with clinicians, pharmacists and compliance colleagues to keep content accurate and compliant with standards such as MHRA rules on prescription-only medicines and GPhC, CQC and ASA/CAP guidance. Use analytics, search and user research data – from tools such as GA4, Google Search Console and Semrush – to understand what patients need, spot gaps and opportunities, and keep improving our journeys based on evidence. Work with SEO and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) colleagues to improve the journey from first search to online consultation, removing friction so it’s clearer for patients and converts better. Own on-page content, structure and metadata standards within our agreed clinical, regulatory and brand guidelines, and help develop our content patterns, style guides and templates for a world where more people find answers through search and AI – first in our component library, then in a new CMS. Later on, help implement and roll out the new CMS, including setting the standards for how it’s used and helping to train colleagues. Champion content design across the business, running sessions and sharing guidance so that content is built to be found from the start.

What You’ll Need To Have

 Proven content design experience, creating accessible, user-centred online content that delivers on a content strategy and meets both business goals and user needs. The ability to take complex technical or clinical information and turn it into clear, easy-to-understand content that helps people achieve their goals. Strong SEO expertise, plus a current, demonstrable understanding of GEO and AEO – including how to optimise content for organic search, AI Overviews and answer engines using structured data and E-E-A-T. Confidence and credibility working in a regulated environment with formal sign-off processes, balancing discoverability and commercial goals against accuracy and compliance. Strong analytical skills, turning data from tools such as GA4, Google Search Console and SEO platforms into clear insight and reporting it in different formats. The confidence to challenge constructively using evidence, while knowing when to compromise so content works for both users and the business. A good understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and writing in plain English for people with different levels of health literacy.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

 Working knowledge of structured data and schema markup, and of Google’s search quality and helpful content guidance for health and other ‘Your Money or Your Life’ (YMYL) topics. Experience creating content in a regulated sector, such as healthcare, pharmacy, pharmaceuticals, finance or another YMYL area. Familiarity with content strategy for AI and answer engines, and ways to measure your content’s visibility and citations in AI-generated answers. An understanding of Agile ways of working in a product or growth team. Experience using experimentation or personalisation platforms, such as AB Tasty, to test and validate content changes.

Rewards Designed For You

 Pension membership Partial paid maternity leave Discretionary annual bonus Generous employee discounts Flexible benefits scheme

There's lots more in our benefits and discounts, MyBoosts - there to give you that little lift in your everyday. Find out more at boots.jobs/rewards

Exclusions may apply (eligible roles only) Please note that any salary estimates provided on third-party sites are not endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.

A Bit About Us

At Boots, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating a place where everyone feels welcome, supported and free to be themselves. We believe that when our people feel valued and included, they thrive, so we're committed to creating a brilliant Boots for our people so they can make a difference for our customers and colleagues every time.

What's Next

If your application is successful, our in-house recruitment team will be in touch to arrange any next steps and to answer any initial questions you have. If you have not been successful on this occasion, you’ll be notified by email.

Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options during the application process. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you to be at your best.

We hope to hear from you soon.

Be brilliant with Boots.

What will you be doing?

You will be one of two dedicated consultants embedded with a leading consumer health client based in Summit, New Jersey, working across some of the most recognized brands in skin care, oral care, and self care. The client has selected Circana as its analytics partner for price and promotion and assortment, and you will be the person who turns model output into decisions. This is a decision advisor role, not a platform operator role. You will frame the business question with the client's RGM, brand, category and customer teams, work with Circana's modeling team to get the right answer, lead the working session, and land a recommendation the client actually takes to market.

You will work across the full program, spanning both price and promotion and assortment, and you will be measured on the commercial decisions you influence, not the number of scenarios you run. You will spend a minimum of two days a week onsite with the client. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Be the trusted advisor to RGM and category teams: Be the day-to-day analytics partner to the client's pricing, RGM, category and brand teams. Understand their planning calendar, their line review cycle, and the retailer conversations they are preparing for, and bring a point of view to those moments rather than waiting to be asked. Earn the seat at the table where pricing and assortment decisions get made. Shape pricing and promotion decisions: Interpret base and promoted price elasticities, cross-price effects, price gaps and thresholds across the client's categories and key retailers. Use Circana's platform to pressure test pricing and promotion scenarios with the client, then translate them into pricing corridors, promotional guidelines and retailer-specific recommendations the client can defend in a buyer meeting. Shape assortment and retailer decisions: Apply demand transferability and incrementality outputs at the retailer and market level to line reviews, new item decisions, delisting and planogram trade-offs. Use assortment simulations, including planogram upload and new item scenarios, to build the retailer story with the client and help them win the line review. Connect analytics to commercial outcomes: Frame the question, coordinate the modeling work, lead the working session, and package the recommendation. Follow the decision through to what happened in market and bring that back to the client so the program is judged on results. Manage the cadence of quarterly refreshes, remodels, new item updates and category reviews so the client always knows what is coming and when. Partner with Circana's delivery teams: Work closely with the Global Solutions modeling team, the Client Insights team on the account, and the dedicated analyst. Own the specs the models depend on (product groupings, attributes, geographies) and make sure what gets built matches what the client will use. Build capability on the client side: Train and support client users on the platforms, run office hours, and raise the client's fluency in elasticities, transferability and optimization so they can self-serve on the routine questions and lean on you for the hard ones. Find the next opportunity: Spot the next question before the client asks it. Actively look for adjacent problems the client is working on, whether in Growth Consulting, demand forecasting, causal analytics or other Circana solutions, and bring them to the commercial lead with a point of view on how to scope them. You will be closer to the client's agenda than anyone else at Circana, and we expect you to use that. Communicate with presence: Present clearly and confidently to senior client stakeholders. Tell the story from what the model says to what the business should do, and be willing to challenge the client's thinking when the data supports it. 

Requirements

10 to 14 years of experience in CPG revenue growth management, pricing and promotion analytics, category management, or a consulting or analytics role serving CPG clientsA track record of using price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability or assortment optimization outputs to influence real pricing, promotion or assortment decisions, and the ability to explain how those models work to a business audienceExperience with Point of Sale, syndicated and panel data; Circana or comparable syndicated data experience strongly preferredDemonstrated ability to lead working sessions, present recommendations to director and VP-level client stakeholders, and hold a position when challengedExperience in consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredFamiliarity with pricing, promotion and assortment simulation platforms preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field; advanced degree in a quantitative discipline preferred but not requiredLocated in or able to commute to Summit, New Jersey a minimum of two days per week

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. rows.title: Research Consultant (Survey)
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

The salary range for this role is $73,000 - $90,000/year + Bonus

Numerator Verified Voices combines verified purchase behavior with mobile surveys to unlock consumer and shopper insights that build stronger brands. Powered by the industry's largest and most diverse consumer purchase panel, our Research Consulting team delivers unmatched insight into consumer influencers, behaviors, and opinions, and we deliver actionable, decision-driving insights for some of the world's leading brands.

As a Research Consultant on Numerator's Research Consulting team, you'll independently own client relationships across a core set of clients and ad-hoc projects. You will act as a trusted advisor to your clients by synthesizing complex data into clear insights, building compelling narratives, and delivering actionable recommendations that strengthen client partnerships and directly influence business decisions. You will guide clients to the right research solution - full-service custom, DIY, or do-it-together - while protecting scope, quality, and timelines. This role requires strong judgment, comfort operating with minimal oversight, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, including thoughtful AI use, comfort with ambiguity, and clear client expectation-setting.

How You’ll Spend Your Time: 

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and ad-hoc projects, owning client relationships end-to-end, delegating to members of your project team as needed, and building strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales, Consulting, and Operations. Own the full project life cycle for client-specific work - from scoping and project design (including proposal writing and pricing as needed) through execution - covering project design, questionnaire development, sample definition, data tabulation and analysis, client-ready deliverables, and presentation of results. Design and deliver both custom, full-service research and tech-enabled, DIY survey solutions on Numerator's platform, guiding clients towards the right approach based on objectives, timelines, budget and capabilities. Support clients using Numerator’s platform by offering the appropriate level of help, whether that means answering questions, providing education, recommending A La Carte services, or supporting subscription-based work. Help clients understand what the platform can do, what support is available, and when a request may need a different service model. Set clear expectations before work begins by clarifying the client’s request, confirming timing and level of effort, and aligning on what is included. Manage scope carefully, especially when client needs fall in the gray area between in-platform support and full-service custom research. Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be one of two dedicated consultants embedded with a leading consumer health client based in Summit, New Jersey, working across some of the most recognized brands in skin care, oral care, and self care. The client has selected Circana as its analytics partner for price and promotion and assortment, and you will be the person who turns model output into decisions. This is a decision advisor role, not a platform operator role. You will frame the business question with the client's RGM, brand, category and customer teams, work with Circana's modeling team to get the right answer, lead the working session, and land a recommendation the client actually takes to market.

You will work across the full program, spanning both price and promotion and assortment, and you will be measured on the commercial decisions you influence, not the number of scenarios you run. You will spend a minimum of two days a week onsite with the client. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Be the trusted advisor to RGM and category teams: Be the day-to-day analytics partner to the client's pricing, RGM, category and brand teams. Understand their planning calendar, their line review cycle, and the retailer conversations they are preparing for, and bring a point of view to those moments rather than waiting to be asked. Earn the seat at the table where pricing and assortment decisions get made. Shape pricing and promotion decisions: Interpret base and promoted price elasticities, cross-price effects, price gaps and thresholds across the client's categories and key retailers. Use Circana's platform to pressure test pricing and promotion scenarios with the client, then translate them into pricing corridors, promotional guidelines and retailer-specific recommendations the client can defend in a buyer meeting. Shape assortment and retailer decisions: Apply demand transferability and incrementality outputs at the retailer and market level to line reviews, new item decisions, delisting and planogram trade-offs. Use assortment simulations, including planogram upload and new item scenarios, to build the retailer story with the client and help them win the line review. Connect analytics to commercial outcomes: Frame the question, coordinate the modeling work, lead the working session, and package the recommendation. Follow the decision through to what happened in market and bring that back to the client so the program is judged on results. Manage the cadence of quarterly refreshes, remodels, new item updates and category reviews so the client always knows what is coming and when. Partner with Circana's delivery teams: Work closely with the Global Solutions modeling team, the Client Insights team on the account, and the dedicated analyst. Own the specs the models depend on (product groupings, attributes, geographies) and make sure what gets built matches what the client will use. Build capability on the client side: Train and support client users on the platforms, run office hours, and raise the client's fluency in elasticities, transferability and optimization so they can self-serve on the routine questions and lean on you for the hard ones. Find the next opportunity: Spot the next question before the client asks it. Actively look for adjacent problems the client is working on, whether in Growth Consulting, demand forecasting, causal analytics or other Circana solutions, and bring them to the commercial lead with a point of view on how to scope them. You will be closer to the client's agenda than anyone else at Circana, and we expect you to use that. Communicate with presence: Present clearly and confidently to senior client stakeholders. Tell the story from what the model says to what the business should do, and be willing to challenge the client's thinking when the data supports it. 

Requirements

10 to 14 years of experience in CPG revenue growth management, pricing and promotion analytics, category management, or a consulting or analytics role serving CPG clientsA track record of using price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability or assortment optimization outputs to influence real pricing, promotion or assortment decisions, and the ability to explain how those models work to a business audienceExperience with Point of Sale, syndicated and panel data; Circana or comparable syndicated data experience strongly preferredDemonstrated ability to lead working sessions, present recommendations to director and VP-level client stakeholders, and hold a position when challengedExperience in consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredFamiliarity with pricing, promotion and assortment simulation platforms preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field; advanced degree in a quantitative discipline preferred but not requiredLocated in or able to commute to Summit, New Jersey a minimum of two days per week

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Northern New Jersey / New York metro, with a minimum of two days per week onsite in Summit, NJ. Limited additional travel (under 5%).

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator’s Data Science team provides statistical and methodological leadership across the organization, developing the methodologies, tools, and data products that support our products.

This is a wide-ranging applied data science role focused primarily on the consumer purchase panel underlying our largest products, with opportunities to contribute to other complex data science initiatives across Numerator’s broader product portfolio. The work combines applied statistics, data investigation, methodology development, and practical implementation. Many of the questions we tackle do not have a single observable right answer, requiring us to combine statistical evidence, product context, and subject-matter judgment to understand tradeoffs and determine whether a solution improves the product as a whole. As your expertise grows, you will take on increasingly complex work and have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, lead projects, improve team practices, and shape how we work.

How You’ll Spend Your Time

Design and implement statistical methodologies that improve the representativeness, stability, and quality of Numerator’s products. Develop data science solutions to problems involving consumer behavior, panel composition, and data quality using techniques such as sampling, weighting, statistical modeling, classification, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and optimization. Build scalable Python and SQL solutions, internal tools, and data products that turn statistical methodologies into reliable production workflows. Develop metrics, monitoring, and validation frameworks to evaluate system performance and identify unexpected or unintended behavior. Contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from problem definition and exploration through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing evaluation. Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and business partners to shape requirements and develop solutions that are both statistically sound and practical to use. Communicate methodologies, findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Physics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Two to five years of industry experience developing and delivering data science solutions. A strong foundation in applied statistics, with experience applying statistical modeling, optimization, or other quantitative methods to real-world data problems. Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience developing reusable, well-structured code and working with large, complex datasets. Comfort working through open-ended problems, investigating unexpected results, and developing solutions with guidance and collaboration, along with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners. Familiarity with survey research or consumer panels—including sampling, weighting, bias correction, imputation, or other methods used to improve representativeness—is helpful but not required. Experience working with user-level or behavioral data is helpful, as is exposure to production data science workflows and tools such as Snowflake, AWS, Airflow, or GitHub. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and workflows, with an interest in applying emerging technologies to improve productivity, learning, and outcomes. 

What We Offer

An inclusive and collaborative company culture—we work in an open environment while working together to get things done and adapt to changing needs as they arise. A market-competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences, and employee resource groups. A great benefits package including health, vision, and dental coverage; a Personal Spending Account; unlimited PTO; flexible scheduling; 401(k) matching; travel reimbursement; and more.

The role
We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, do-er to act as the guardian of our measurement framework and the engine behind its operations. In this role, you will have the opportunity to champion our sources of truth as well as plan, lead and unify the cross channel delivery of test & learn agendas.
Sitting at the intersection of our media channel leads and our analytics specialists, you will ensure our Marketing Mix Models (MMM) are fed with the right data and that our Test & Learn ideas are translated into rigorous, actionable experiments. 
Main responsibilities
MMM Operations 
 As the primary point of contact for all data sharing and queries from MMM partners, you will manage a timely process of gathering, cleaning, and formatting media delivery and performance data for our econometric models.Accuracy & Quality Assurance: Ensuring all shared data is accurately formatted and reflects the reality of our media activity across all platforms. Performance Interpretation and storytelling: Assist in interpreting model results, helping to translate statistical outputs into a clear story focused on which channels are under-performing, and where the opportunity for growth lies.Agency partner: Maintain regular contact with our econometrics agency partners. In this position you will manage the flow of requests, ensure adherence to briefs, and interrogate recommendations where necessary. Internally you will champion their work and ensure engagement with the output.Evolution and innovation: To maximise the impact and effectiveness of our model, you will consider opportunities to further improve the data feed. By maintaining knowledge of industry best practice, and building a strong relationship with relevant contacts, you will have the opportunity to maximise the impact of MMM throughout the wider business.
 Experimentation rollout
In collaboration with channel managers, you will manage the measurement framework and experimentation roadmap. In which we will detail our test and learn priorities that you will spearhead as the year goes on.Learning Prioritisation: Own the rollout of the experimentation and measurement roadmap. Ensuring the tests deemed most important are executed in timely and rigorous manners.The "Knowledge Bank": Maintain the central test & learn log. Documenting every outcome, and sharing those with wider stakeholders to ensure that learnings are actively used to ameliorate media plans.Technical Translation: Collaborate with specialists and analysts to take ambitious ideas from Channel Leads (owned and paid), and translate them into technical briefs for specialists to build. Initiative Support: Design and set up cross-channel Test & Learn initiatives, including A/B testing, Meta/Google Lift studies, and regional Geo-tests across both owned and paid media.

Have demonstrable experience within a media business. Either agency (Data/Analytics/Planning/ Transformation) or an in-house effectiveness operations role.Experience with both paid and owned media with an ability to evidence the nuances in their measurement challenges.Proven experience working across multiple media channels.Proven experience working with, Marketing Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution, and Incrementality Testing.Familiarity with the “plumbing” of measurement - how pixels, APIs and Clean Rooms function to collect data.Experience managing relationships with third-party measurement partners.

You will be detail orientated - That could manifest in being able to spot errors that others may overlook, or to ensure excellence in every data sheet you share. You are highly organised and capable of managing multiple work streams between different teams with competing deadlines.

rows.title: Senior Data Engineer, Python, Spark
rows.descriptionText:
Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on? The mission of Roku’s Data Engineering team is to develop a world-class big data platform that empowers both internal and external partners to leverage data and drive business growth. The team works closely with business stakeholders and engineering colleagues to collect, transform and surface metrics that are critical to the success of new and existing initiatives.As a Senior Data Engineer in the Viewer Product Device & Themed Experiences team, you’ll play a pivotal role in designing data models and building scalable pipelines to capture business metrics across Roku devices, Roku Powered TVs, web, and mobile clients. This work is essential to helping Roku understand which features resonate most with users and how we can continue to improve their experience. What is the role? Roku pioneered TV streaming. We connect users to the content they love, enable publishers to build and monetise large audiences, and give advertisers unique opportunities to engage consumers. Roku streaming players and Roku TV™ models are available worldwide through direct retail and licensing partnerships with TV brands and pay-TV operators.With tens of millions of devices sold across multiple countries, thousands of streaming channels, and billions of hours watched, a scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant big data platform is critical to our continued success. How will I use AI at Roku? 
At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. rows.title: Lead Product Owner- Mortgage Pricing
rows.descriptionText:
If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.We're one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Lead Product Owner - Mortgage Pricing.
This is a hybrid working role with a base location of Birmingham, Leeds, Sheffield, or Chester. You'll join a high-profile team at the forefront of Mortgage Pricing strategy, helping shape customer propositions and drive growth across one of HSBC UK's most important lending portfolios.This is a key specialist leadership role within the Customer Intelligence team responsible for supporting the successful development, implementation and ongoing management of Mortgage Pricing capabilities. The role holder will contribute to shaping along with being responsible for implementing and continuously optimising mortgage pricing across the portfolio, critical to Driving Lending Growth, one of HSBC RBW’s key strategic objectives. The role combines deep mortgage market expertise, commercial judgement and advanced analytics to deliver sustainable lending growth, competitive customer propositions and disciplined returns within risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
Playing a critical role in delivering lending growth, you will combine deep mortgage market expertise, commercial judgement, and advanced analytics to drive competitive customer propositions, sustainable portfolio performance, and disciplined returns, whilst ensuring compliance with regulatory and risk requirements.
As an HSBC employee in the UK, you'll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.
In this role you will:Build and enhance pricing models, elasticity analysis, scenario testing and forecasting to support pricing decisions and performance outcomesDevelop and manage mortgage pricing across new business, product transfers and retention, balancing customer value, competitiveness, profitability, and risk-adjusted returns alongside other key performance indicatorsTranslate funding, capital, liquidity, and credit risk considerations into effective product-level pricing recommendationsMonitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer behaviour, turning insight into timely pricing actions and clearly explaining trade-offs, sensitivities, risks and expected outcomes to senior stakeholdersProvide commercial insight and clear recommendations to senior stakeholders, outlining risks, trade-offs, and expected business impactsContinuously improve mortgage pricing capability through data, automation, and process enhancements to support growth and customer outcomesEnsure pricing models are appropriately governed, monitored, and maintained, identifying performance issues early and taking timely action to avoid adverse impacts.Partner with Product and Finance teams to enable effective pricing governance, including approvals, controls, monitoring and post-implementation review, while supporting compliance with Consumer Duty, fair value, responsible lending and internal risk policies.Work closely with the Financial Modelling team to define, challenge and maintain aligned assumptions across pricing and financial models, ensuring consistency in forecasts, scenarios and commercial decision-making.Act as a subject-matter expert for mortgage pricing, continuously identifying opportunities to achieve best-in-class capability, automate decisioning and strengthen portfolio performance through data, experimentation and process improvement.
To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:Extensive experience in UK mortgage pricing, product management, portfolio management, commercial finance, or a closely related lending discipline (essential)Deep knowledge of mortgage products, customer segments, distribution channels, retention strategies, and mortgage profitability driversStrong understanding of funds transfer pricing, swap curves, liquidity and capital costs, credit risk, expected loss, margin, and risk-adjusted return measuresAdvanced analytical and modelling capabilities with experience using pricing tools and data platforms such as SQL, SAS (essential), Python, GCP, BigQuery or LookerAbility to interpret market and portfolio data, assess elasticity and sensitivities, and translate complex analysis into commercial pricing decisionsExcellent stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills, with the ability to provide constructive challenge and make recommendations under pressure (essential)Strong knowledge of UK mortgage regulation, Consumer Duty, fair value principles, responsible lending, pricing governance and model and data controls

rows.title: Head of AI Transformation | S5 | Data & AI Domain | London & Milton Keynes
rows.descriptionText:
Country: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

The Data & AI Domain at Santander is responsible for setting the strategic direction for data, analytics, and artificial intelligence across the organisation. It ensures that data is managed as a trusted enterprise asset and that advanced technologies are applied responsibly, securely, and effectively to create value for customers and the business.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE 

The Data & AI Domain is looking for a Head of AI Transformation based out of London and Milton Keynes.

The Head of AI Transformation is responsible for leading Santander UK’s enterprise-wide adoption of artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to drive business transformation. This role oversees the data science and AI function, ensuring the effective development, deployment, and scaling of AI capabilities across the organisation.

The role holder partners with senior business, technology, risk, and operations leaders to define and execute a strategic AI transformation roadmap aligned to Santander Group priorities and UK business objectives. They are accountable for embedding AI-driven decision-making into core processes, accelerating value creation, and ensuring robust governance, ethical standards, and regulatory compliance across all AI initiatives.

This individual plays a critical leadership role in translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into tangible business outcomes, fostering a culture of innovation, and positioning Santander UK as a leader in responsible AI adoption within the financial services sector.

They are a member of the Data and AI Domain UK Leadership team, are part of the global AI Leadership team and a key influencers of strategic direction for Santander UK We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

Responsibilities

AI Transformation Strategy & Roadmap Define, own, and deliver the Santander UK AI transformation strategy and roadmap, aligned with Group direction and UK business priorities. Leadership of Data Science & AI Function Lead and develop the UK data science and AI teams, ensuring high performance, strong technical capability, and alignment to strategic outcomes. Enterprise AI Adoption Drive the adoption of AI and advanced analytics across business units, embedding AI into key customer journeys, operations, and decision-making processes. Deployment of Group AI Products Lead the localisation, deployment, and scaling of Santander Group AI products within the UK business, ensuring relevance, performance, and value delivery. Business Value Realisation Ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable business impact, including revenue growth, cost optimisation, risk reduction, and improved customer experience. 

What You’ll Bring

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience

AI Product / Operating Model (Required):

Shapes an enterprise operating model that enables rapid and responsible delivery of AI products and capabilities. Champions agile, product-led ways of working across business and technology teams to accelerate value realisation. Balances delivery speed with governance, risk management and regulatory requirements. 

Enterprise transformation enabled by AI (Required):

Defines and delivers enterprise AI transformation aligned to business strategy and Santander Group priorities. Identifies opportunities to redesign customer journeys, operations and decision-making through AI and advanced analytics. Leads organisational change required to embed AI capabilities and realise measurable business outcomes. 

Technical capability (AI/ML) (Required):

Demonstrates deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science and advanced analytics, with the ability to translate emerging technologies into scalable business solutions and strategic outcomes. Provides technical leadership and governance across the AI lifecycle, ensuring solutions are designed, deployed and operated in line with regulatory requirements, model risk standards, security, and Responsible AI principles. Maintains a strong understanding of modern AI platforms, data architectures, cloud technologies and MLOps practices, enabling informed decisions on technology strategy, vendor selection, and enterprise AI capability development 

Banking Products and Services (Required):

Demonstrates strong understanding of UK retail and commercial banking products, customer journeys and value drivers. Identifies opportunities where AI and analytics can improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency and risk management. Partners with business leaders to embed AI into core products, processes and services 

Cross-functional Collaboration (Required):

Knowledge of collaborative techniques and approaches; ability to promote a culture of continuous improvement and working together across functions to solve business problems and meet business goals. Uses specific network of leaderships or experts to help achieve organizational and client goals. Builds trusted partnerships across Business, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Operations to drive enterprise AI adoption. Influences senior executives across Santander UK and Santander Group to align priorities and accelerate delivery. Creates a collaborative environment that enables delivery of cross-functional transformation programmes. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking (Required):

Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyse situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Makes strategic investment decisions balancing business value, technical feasibility and regulatory obligations. Evaluates competing AI opportunities and prioritises initiatives delivering the greatest enterprise value. Applies sound judgement in managing technology, operational, conduct and model risks. 

Communicating for Impact (Required):

Communicates a compelling vision for AI transformation across all organisational levels. Influences Executive Committee and Board stakeholders through clear, evidence-based recommendations. Builds confidence in AI through transparent communication of opportunities, risks and outcomes. Interprets business plans or solutions to top management to gain both collective intelligence and support. 

Strategic Thinking (Required):

Knowledge of the importance of "big picture" thinking and planning; ability to apply organizational acumen and competitiveness to identify and maintain focus on key success factors for the organization. Directs strategic alliances and partnerships for mutual benefit. Develops long-term AI strategy aligned with business priorities, emerging technologies and market trends. Anticipates regulatory, competitive and technological developments to position Santander UK as a leader in responsible AI. Creates strategic partnerships that accelerate AI capability and innovation. 

Team Management (Required):

Leads and develops high-performing multidisciplinary teams including Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Product Managers and AI Specialists. Builds organisational capability in AI through coaching, succession planning and talent development. Creates an inclusive, innovative culture that attracts and retains leading AI talent. 

Technical & Non-Technical Skills/Knowledge

Significant leadership experience in AI, Data Science or Advanced Analytics within a large, complex organisation. Demonstrable experience defining and delivering enterprise AI or digital transformation strategies. Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, Responsible AI and financial services regulation. Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and building high-performing AI capabilities. Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and deliver complex cross-functional transformation programmes. Strong commercial acumen with experience delivering measurable business value from AI and analytics investments. Knowledge of modern AI platforms, cloud technologies, MLOps and enterprise data architectures. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including engagement with Executive Committees and Board-level governance. 

Education

Undergraduate degree in business or similar related field or substantial and relevant work experience supported by professional certifications/licences (Required)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.

Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 31 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year. £8,500 car allowance per year. Company funded private medical insurance for you and your familyCompany funded Health screenings every two years. Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover. Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans. As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and servicesCompetitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring. Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support. Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support. Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve. Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network. 

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.

We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.

To make this possible, our roles are site-based with a hybrid working pattern, where colleagues are expected to attend the office at least 12 days per month (pro-rata for part-time roles).

When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen office location(s).

Right to work in the UK

Every individual must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander either by way of nationality, visa or work permit. If you do require a working visa / permit this will not influence our decision on whether to progress your application. However, if you do not have a right to work, or an application for a working visa / permit is unsuccessful, Santander will not proceed with your application and will withdraw any conditional offer previously made. 

We welcome applications on the understanding that, should you be offered this role, there may be no relocation package available. Santander will pay the employer mandatory government fees that are required to pay in connection with visa sponsorship. You may be liable for your own personal employee immigration and relocation costs.

What To Do Next

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk.

rows.title: Director - Responsible AI (Risk & Control) HBUK
rows.descriptionText:
Ready to set HSBC UK’s standard for safe and fair AI? Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

Head of Responsible Artificial Intelligence is a senior role within HSBC UK Business Risk & Resilience, shaping how we govern and oversee AI and GenAI across the bank. You’ll set the risk and controls strategy and provide oversight so AI is designed, deployed and operated safely, fairly and securely in line with UK regulatory expectations and HSBC UK’s risk appetite. Working across HSBC UK and with Group stakeholders, you’ll provide effective scrutiny across the AI lifecycle and support accountable decision-making for material AI use cases. You’ll also set expectations for operational resilience and third-party assurance for AI solutions. Success means clear decision rights, consistent governance outcomes and decision-ready reporting that strengthens customer outcomes, colleague impact and the bank’s resilience.

This role can be based in Birmingham, Sheffield, Leeds or Manchester

What You'll Be Doing

Define risk and minimum control standards for AI and GenAI use cases including monitoring thresholds for customer-facing and material decisioning applicationsEstablish the governance operating model for HSBC UK AI use cases including decision rights and escalation routes and ensure adherence across governance meetingsOversee controls across the AI lifecycle including use-case intake, data suitability, development, validation, deployment, monitoring, change management and decommissioningTranslate UK supervisory expectations into practical requirements and evidence covering governance, model risk, operational resilience, consumer outcomes and third-party riskSet operational resilience expectations for AI services including impact tolerances, dependency mapping, testing approaches and recoverabilityCoordinate response to AI-related incidents including root cause analysis and sustainable remediation trackingSet assurance requirements for third-party AI solutions covering transparency, auditability, data rights, security and exit plans and oversee ongoing monitoringProvide decision-ready MI and reporting to senior risk committees on AI inventory, materiality, KRIs and KPIs, issues, incidents and remediation progress and support internal and regulatory reviews

What we're looking for

Senior experience in risk, governance, assurance or control design for AI or analytics in a regulated environmentStrong understanding of AI and GenAI risk domains including fairness and bias, explainability, privacy, security, data governance, model risk, conduct and consumer outcomes and operational resilienceProven experience translating UK regulatory and supervisory expectations into workable governance, controls and evidenceExperience providing scrutiny and oversight across an end-to-end AI lifecycleAbility to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making in senior forumsExperience building effective networks across a matrix structure including with Compliance (RC), Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and LegalPeople management experience including building capability through training, playbooks and communities of practiceExperience producing clear MI for senior stakeholders including AI inventory, materiality, KRIs and KPIs and issue and remediation tracking

Responsible AI Governance for HSBC UK

If you want to shape how a major UK bank governs AI and GenAI this role offers the scope to set standards that translate into better decisions and stronger outcomes. You’ll work across business lines and risk stewards to put clear controls and oversight around material AI use cases. You’ll also strengthen operational resilience and third-party assurance in an area that’s evolving quickly. Apply to help embed responsible innovation across HSBC UK.

Opening up a world of opportunity.

At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. rows.title: Associate, Global Investor Access - EMEA
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking a professional to join our team in the role of Associate, Global Investor Access - EMEA.

Global Investor Access (GIA) in EMEA delivers thought leadership content and corporate access solutions for institutional investors across asset classes and client segments within Markets and Securities Services. This role sits at the centre of how we bring investors together with corporates, sector experts and HSBC content through non-deal roadshows, corporate days, conferences, expert events and bespoke access requests.

This is a specialist, execution-focused front-office support role within a markets-facing environment and will coordinate activity across Sales, Research, Events and corporate issuers. The role also supports sourcing global content from across the bank for regional, overseas and global clients and events. You’ll use internal systems, data and analytics to capture feedback, assess event impact and identify ways to simplify processes including through AI Markets tools while maintaining strong control standards.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role You’ll

 Own end-to-end execution of Global Markets corporate access across EMEA, covering non-deal roadshows, conferences, corporate days, webinars, expert events and investor tours  Coordinate Investor Relations engagement between corporates, Research and Global Markets Sales, turning coverage priorities into agendas, schedules and logistics  Manage institutional investor access enquiries and allocations, providing timely confirmations and accurate follow-through from request through to completion  Shape and distribute thematic marketing for roadshows, tours and access activity, aligning outreach with business priorities across Markets and Securities Services  Source and package global content from across HSBC for regional, overseas and global clients and events in EMEA  Host onsite and virtual sessions as an HSBC brand ambassador, supporting a professional experience for corporate and institutional investors  Monitor attendance and engagement and coordinate post-event actions with Sales and other stakeholders to close the loop with clients  Use internal applications, data tools and AI Markets tools to interpret feedback, assess value and streamline processes while maintaining strong control standards 

To be successful in this role you’ll meet the following requirements:

 Must have relevant experience in corporate access, coordination or markets-related event execution within financial services.  Must have relevant level of knowledge of Corporate and Institutional investors and what events and corporate access activity they attend  Demonstrate sound knowledge of Global Markets products, sectors, asset classes and client segments  Have a good commercial analysis capability  Excellent written and verbal communication skills to be able to work with various sources of information to produce easily digestible reports and presentations  Possess very good stakeholder management skills, coupled with a professional confidence that engender the view of a ‘Trusted Partner’ across a varied internal and external audience  Demonstrate really good time management, planning and organisational skills with the ability to managing multiple tasks often with conflicting priorities  Understand the Risk and Control and Regulatory governance of a Financial Services setting
